property_summary: For any admissible call to fallback with exactly 10 ether, if the transfer condition according to the original logic (block.number % 15 == 0) is true, the contract's balance must be 0 after the call; the buggy version uses block.timestamp % 15 == 0 and may leave a non-zero balance when block.number % 15 == 0 but block.timestamp % 15 != 0.
change_summary: Change the ether transfer condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.timestamp % 15 == 0.
